description: Amgen Inc. discovers, develops, manufactures and delivers innovative medicines to fight some of the world's toughest diseases, focusing on areas of high unmet medical need and leveraging its expertise to improve people's lives while reducing the social and economic burden of disease. It helped launch the biotechnology industry more than 45 years ago and has grown to be one of the world's leading independent biotechnology companies, with a robust pipeline of potential first-in-class medicines at all stages of development and a presence in approximately 100 countries. Amgen was incorporated in California in 1980, became a Delaware corporation in 1987, and operates in one operating segment, human therapeutics.
